scope: Meaning and case decisions for the current task bank, not a universal homograph rule.

rules.reason: Accusative plural hands, rather than genitive singular of a hand.
Nominative plural clouds; из облака keeps genitive singular.
Plural places; много места keeps singular genitive.
Count construction uses genitive singular ноги́; uncounted nominative plural remains но́ги. NSU homograph entries distinguish these cases.

Counted inanimate берег after два/оба uses genitive singular бе́рега, also in the accusative object оба берега; uncounted nominative plural is берега́. NSU source explicitly records genitive singular бе+рега.
